title: Figma header lookalikes, placeholders and public identifiers
summary: Longer or suffixed header names carrying an identifier, placeholders, environment references and masked displays under the exact header, and public Figma identifiers.
rationale: A longer name such as X-Figma-Token-Id is a different header, a placeholder or reference stands in for a value that is kept elsewhere, a masked display has no recoverable value, and a file key or user id is a public identifier. Protecting any of these would redact text a reader needs and would extend the exact-name claim beyond what it states.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged under project policy: the values here are identifiers, placeholders, references or masked text, not credential values. That a placeholder or reference is not a value is a project decision, not a Figma statement.

sources.supports: passing the token to the API in the X-Figma-Token header of your request.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
